targets.rawSql:
SELECT
    COUNT(*) FILTER (
        WHERE $__timeFilter(requested_at)
    )::bigint
        AS "AI_REQUESTS",

    CASE
        WHEN COUNT(*) FILTER (
            WHERE
                $__timeFilter(requested_at)
                AND status IN (
                    'COMPLETED',
                    'FAILED',
                    'ERROR',
                    'TIMEOUT',
                    'CANCELLED'
                )
        ) = 0
        THEN NULL

        ELSE ROUND(
            100.0
            * COUNT(*) FILTER (
                WHERE
                    $__timeFilter(requested_at)
                    AND status = 'COMPLETED'
            )
            /
            NULLIF(
                COUNT(*) FILTER (
                    WHERE
                        $__timeFilter(requested_at)
                        AND status IN (
                            'COMPLETED',
                            'FAILED',
                            'ERROR',
                            'TIMEOUT',
                            'CANCELLED'
                        )
                ),
                0
            ),
            1
        )
    END
        AS "AI_SUCCESS_RATE",

    COUNT(*) FILTER (
        WHERE
            $__timeFilter(requested_at)
            AND status IN (
                'PROCESSING',
                'RUNNING',
                'IN_PROGRESS'
            )
    )::bigint
        AS "AI_PROCESSING",

    COUNT(*) FILTER (
        WHERE
            $__timeFilter(requested_at)
            AND status IN (
                'FAILED',
                'ERROR',
                'TIMEOUT',
                'CANCELLED'
            )
    )::bigint
        AS "AI_FAILED",

    COUNT(*) FILTER (
        WHERE
            $__timeFilter(requested_at)
            AND status = 'COMPLETED'
    )::bigint
        AS "AI_COMPLETED",

    COUNT(*) FILTER (
        WHERE
            $__timeFilter(requested_at)
            AND status IN (
                'PENDING',
                'QUEUED',
                'REQUESTED'
            )
    )::bigint
        AS "AI_QUEUED"

FROM ai_aianalysis

panels.title: AI 처리 상태 분포

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
    COUNT(*) FILTER (
        WHERE status = 'COMPLETED'
    )::bigint AS "완료",

    COUNT(*) FILTER (
        WHERE status IN (
            'FAILED',
            'ERROR',
            'TIMEOUT',
            'CANCELLED'
        )
    )::bigint AS "실패",

    COUNT(*) FILTER (
        WHERE status IN (
            'PROCESSING',
            'RUNNING',
            'IN_PROGRESS'
        )
    )::bigint AS "처리 중",

    COUNT(*) FILTER (
        WHERE status IN (
            'PENDING',
            'QUEUED',
            'REQUESTED'
        )
    )::bigint AS "대기"
FROM ai_aianalysis
WHERE $__timeFilter(requested_at)

panels.title: AI 실패 발생 추이

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
    $__timeGroupAlias(requested_at,'1h'),
    COUNT(*)::double precision
        AS "실패"
FROM ai_aianalysis
WHERE
    $__timeFilter(requested_at)
    AND status IN (
        'FAILED',
        'ERROR',
        'TIMEOUT',
        'CANCELLED'
    )
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

SELECT
    requested_at
        AS "요청 시각",

    id::text
        AS "Analysis ID",

    analysis_type
        AS "분석 유형",

    status
        AS "상태",

    COALESCE(
        failure_code,
        '-'
    )
        AS "오류 코드",

    COALESCE(
        trace_id::text,
        '-'
    )
        AS request_id,

    CASE
        WHEN trace_id IS NULL
        THEN '-'

        ELSE
            'ERR-'
            ||
            UPPER(
                SUBSTRING(
                    REPLACE(
                        trace_id::text,
                        '-',
                        ''
                    )
                    FROM 1 FOR 16
                )
            )
    END
        AS "오류 참조번호"

FROM ai_aianalysis

WHERE $__timeFilter(requested_at)

ORDER BY requested_at DESC

LIMIT 300
